entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi... yes, I'm a bit lost. I'm trying to figure out a return. I have this jersey but the website is so confusing. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Not a problem at all. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's just the wrong size. I really liked the color, but when I tried it on, it was just way too tight. I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the process. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can handle this directly for you. Let's get this sorted out. Do you have your order number handy, or I can look it up with the email address you used for the purchase?
I think the email is easier. It's sarah.jenkins@email.com.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull up your account... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Level Cycling Jersey, delivered about 70 days ago. I also see you're a VIP member with us, so thank you for your loyalty.
And I have good news for you. That jersey is one of our standard items, which falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you're at day 70, you are well within the window to get that processed.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I had waited too long. That's a huge relief.

Not at all. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You can just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we can either issue a full refund or process that exchange for the correct size.

Also, as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've added a complimentary expedited shipping voucher to your account for your next purchase. You can use that to get your new jersey size out to you even faster.
Wow, that's amazing! You've made this so easy. Thank you so much, David!
It's my pleasure, Sarah. I'm glad I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
